How We Hire

Our four-stage hiring process is designed to understand your strengths, introduce our team, and ensure mutual alignment from our first conversation to your first day.

Send your CV / Application
  1. 01

    Getting to know you intro call

    An informal introductory conversation to learn about your background, career aspirations, and answer any questions you have about DVT.

  2. 02

    Manager's interview

    A comprehensive discussion with the hiring manager focusing on role expectations, relevant experience, technical domain, and team collaboration.

  3. 03

    Show us your skills

    A practical assessment, technical challenge, or portfolio walkthrough tailored to your discipline to demonstrate your hands-on capabilities.

  4. 04

    Final decision

    We review feedback across all interview rounds, evaluate mutual alignment, and share a clear, transparent outcome and offer details promptly.
